title: Tambourine and maracas in Duke's band
summary: He played tambourine and sometimes maracas on Spanish pieces, the first percussion of that kind Duke's band had.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Barry Ulanov in his book mentions that you were playing maracas as well as, clavés trombone.
Well, I was playing the tambourine, the maracas sometimes, and some of my tunes and some matines -- you know, Spanish things like that.
This was the first time that Duke ever had any percussion like that, wasn't it?
Sonny Greer never had anything like that.
